t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The position of the gnome, their size or their hat makes no difference. However, a pair of gnomes will appear and one gnome will lead you to a dark forest, and one will lead you to a bright forest. The goal is to find which gnome leads you to the most mushrooms. The key is to work out which gnome produces the most harvested mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: I have no idea how this works so my only advice would be to pay attention and see if you can find the correlation between which gnome and which forest produces the best harvest. Remember the size, hat and location of the gnome makes no difference. The red, orange, green and blue gnomes take you to a bright forest. The brown, pink, purple and yellow gnomes take to you a dark forest.Good luck and I hope you did better than me!
